title: Zoho Campaigns Just Got AI Agents + WhatsApp #Shorts
description:
Zoho just rebuilt Zoho Campaigns: AI agent workflows through MCP, native WhatsApp campaigns and frequency capping across email, SMS and WhatsApp. Here is how to put an AI agent to work on your campaigns while you keep the final approval.

1. First, connect your AI client to Zoho Campaigns through MCP, and give it only the permissions you want.
2. Then ask in plain English, like: build a re-engagement campaign for contacts who stopped opening our emails.
3. Add a WhatsApp step with an approved template, and turn on frequency capping across email, SMS and WhatsApp.
4. Finally, review the draft, send yourself a test, then approve and schedule it.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho Campaigns AI agent workflows
- endpoint: Model Context Protocol (MCP) support in Zoho Campaigns
- docs: Zoho Campaigns help

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://itbrief.com.au/story/zoho-adds-ai-agent-workflows-to-campaigns-platform

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

story.title: Zoho adds AI agent workflows to Campaigns platform
story.summary: Zoho rebuilt Zoho Campaigns (reported 30 Oct - 5 Nov 2026): AI agent workflows through Model Context Protocol (MCP) support - connected AI agents build, schedule and analyse campaigns from plain-English instructions, limited to the permissions the business sets, with review and approval; examples: a seasonal campaign for an existing segment, adapting a top past campaign, a re-engagement campaign for inactive contacts. Native WhatsApp marketing: bulk campaigns with approved templates, WhatsApp steps in automated workflows. Frequency capping across email, SMS and WhatsApp. Zia Content Analyser drafts subject lines and copy. Live Zoho CRM sync. Paid plans from $4 a month; SMS / WhatsApp need message credits; free plan up to 500 contacts.
